lead: A probe `.nvs` file without `<?nvs` on its first line is template text, so `nvs check` passes and `nvs run` prints the source.
body: Code mode starts only at `<?nvs`, and `<?php` is refused with `E0229`. A generated stress input that skips the tag measures the text path and can report "no crash" for code that crashes. Start every generated probe with `<?nvs\n`, and confirm the run reaches a diagnostic or output from the code itself; the open tags are lexed in `crates/nvs-syntax/src/token.rs`.
